params.prompt: NO armour, NO plates, NO ridges on the head, NO robotic or mechanical features, NO seams, NO helmet-like skull, NO sockets or rings set into the head. A near-photorealistic macro photograph of a single Boophis tree frog, slightly stylised so it works as an icon: clean shapes and a strong readable silhouette. The frog sits upright and alert, facing LEFT in 3/4 view, head slightly raised, the far eye just visible over the snout. Translucent mint and aqua skin with a wet moist sheen, a pale cream throat and belly, small red-orange speckles on the snout and back, and a few larger red spots on the back and thigh; the spots are flat pigment, not bumps. Translucent pale-green adhesive toe discs, with light passing through the toes and the edges of the limbs. SOFT ORGANIC ROUNDED FROG HEAD with soft smooth skin over the whole skull, eyes bulging naturally out of the skin like soft domes; a smooth continuous skull line from the rounded snout to the back, no ridges, plates, armour or mechanical-looking seams; the nostrils sit near the snout tip; a visible round tympanum (eardrum) behind the eye, smaller than the eye, with a faint skin fold above it. EYE: large and bulging, set on top and to the side of the head, with an electric-blue outer ring, an orange-brown iris, and a full black pupil that is a wide HORIZONTAL OVAL (about twice as wide as tall, not a round dot and not a thin slit) with a small bright white highlight; alert, not sleepy. FRONT LEGS: short upper arm and short forearm with a visible bent elbow, hands turned slightly inward under the chest; each hand has exactly 4 fingers, each ending in one round disc, only partly webbed. HIND LEGS: folded beside the body in a clear Z-fold, thigh then shank then a long tarsus and foot, knee forward, heel near the hip; each hind foot has exactly 5 toes, each ending in one round disc, extensively webbed with translucent webbing; every foot clearly attached to its leg. Smooth to finely granular back, coarsely granular belly. Soft studio light. Single frog, whole frog visible, fully transparent background, no ground, no plate, no shadow, no reflection. Slightly denser speckles. Soft organic amphibian skin everywhere, no hard edges.
